facts.fact_text: On 6 May 2012 a public demonstration entitled the 'March of Millions' was held in central Moscow.
The march on 6 May 2012 was peaceful and held without any disruptions.

The Justice of the Peace of Court Circuit no. 100 of the Yakimanka District of Moscow questioned two witnesses for the defence in the case of the first applicant (Mr Aristov).

The Justice of the Peace of Court Circuit no. 100 of the Yakimanka District of Moscow dismissed as unreliable the testimony of defence witnesses, who stated that the first applicant (Mr Aristov) had not chanted any slogans in their presence and had not participated in breaking the cordon.
